title: The Year AI Became Invisible
narrative: AI agents handle daily tasks. Quantum computing reaches new milestones. Spatial computing finds its audience. Global AI regulation takes shape. Open-source AI democratizes access. AI-native creative tools transform industries. AI wearables launch. The technology stopped being a novelty and became infrastructure.
